name: Billie Cavallaro
headline: Principal Product Designer focused on agentic AI and design systems

current_role.title: Principal Product Designer
current_role.focus: Infusing AI into risk and controls workstreams

summary: Billie is a principal product designer who ships AI products in a regulated industry. At Capital One he designed and shipped Fuse Assist, the company's first AI risk product, from concept to production. Before that, at Discover, he unified seven internal risk products on a shared design system. He's also a founder: he built Space Shake into a $5.2M brand and closed deals on Shark Tank. He describes himself as an ideas guy who takes on big problems and reimagines how people work, starting with where they enter the workflow.

highlights.text: Designed and shipped Fuse Assist, Capital One's first AI risk product, from concept to production: a chat-based advisor that helps people create risk records start to finish.
Leading the Phase 2 rollout of Fuse Assist across Risks, Assessments, Issues, Events and Audit workflows.

At Discover, unified seven internal risk products (Risks, Controls, Regulatory Change Management, Issues, Events, TPRM, Policy) by partnering with the Horizon Design System team, and contributed components back into the customer-facing system.
Co-founded Prompts and Pixels, a cross-functional internal AI community at Capital One, and acts as the AI champion on his design team.
Founded and led Space Shake, a keto shake brand (with a companion tracker app) that grew to $5.2M, closing deals with Coca-Cola and Charles Barkley on Shark Tank.
Designed and built billie.mcp, a Model Context Protocol server that lets AI agents ask about his work, check role fit, request case studies and find his products.
